Definition: from G4862 and G4727; to moan jointly, i.e. (figuratively) experience a common calamity:--groan together.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the whole creation groans together in travail, waiting for the revealing of the sons of God. The groaning is shared, not solitary: every part of a broken world feels it at once. It is one of the few places where Scripture lets the whole creation speak with one voice.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this verse is why the world's ache feels so personal: creation itself is waiting for the same redemption we are.
